title: 1812 Prairie's south wall rises past its roof as a coped parapet
items: The south wall of George H. Wheeler's house at 1812 Prairie Avenue now rises past the edge of its slate roof to a heavy stone-capped top, as both photographs of the house show it. The slate roof used to slope away from the wall there. The tall south chimney now stands against the outside of that wall, in the gap to the house next door, and runs down to the ground. It used to sit on the wall's top edge. With no gutter along the raised wall, its two drainpipes are gone; one pipe now runs down the back wall instead.
